supplements.title: Ginsenoside Rg3 potentiates cisplatin antitumor activity while mitigating nephrotoxicity through SIRT1‑mediated suppression of the NLRP3 inflammasome.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rg3 enhances cisplatin's effectiveness against lung cancer while protecting kidneys from drug damage.

supplements.title: Multi-omics dissection of lignan diversity and therapeutic potential in Ocimum: Identification of diphyllin as an anti-inflammatory agent targeting TNF-α signaling.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified diphyllin from Ocimum plants as a compound that reduces inflammation by blocking TNF-α signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Banxia Xiexin decoction alleviates N-methyl-N'-nitro-N-nitrosoguanidine-induced gastric precancerous lesions by modulating the gastric microbiota.
supplements.summary: Traditional herbal formula Banxia Xiexin decoction reduces gastric precancerous lesions by changing stomach bacteria composition.

supplements.title: Comprehensive toxicological profiling of Costus pictus D. Don methanolic leaf extract using in-vitro and in-vivo model.
supplements.summary: Researchers tested Costus pictus leaf extract for safety and toxicity to validate its traditional use in treating diabetes and other conditions.

supplements.title: Taohong siwu decoction alleviates hand-foot skin reaction by regulating RAGE-mediated keratinocyte apoptosis and autophagy.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese medicine formula reduces painful hand-foot skin reactions caused by common cancer drugs by protecting skin cells from damage.

supplements.title: Integrated computational and experimental analysis explores FOLH1 expression patterns across cancers and nominates melatonin as a potential modulator in prostate cancer models.
supplements.summary: Researchers found that melatonin may help regulate FOLH1 protein expression in prostate cancer cells.

supplements.title: The human microbiome in cancer: Not just a sidekick anymore.
supplements.summary: Bacteria in the human microbiome significantly influence cancer development, progression, and treatment response across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Berberine and its structural diversity: structure-activity relationships, molecular mechanisms, and drug discovery opportunities.
supplements.summary: Berberine, a natural compound, shows promise against cancer and other diseases, but researchers are redesigning its structure to improve effectiveness and drugability.

supplements.title: Thymoquinone inhibits proliferation and impairs wound closure dynamics via apoptosis and autophagy-related pathways in multiple cancer cell lines.
supplements.summary: Thymoquinone, a compound from nigella seeds, stops cancer cell growth by triggering cell death across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Dual modulation of Wnt and inflammatory pathways by Gingerenone a inhibits colorectal tumorigenesis.
supplements.summary: Gingerenone A, a ginger compound, blocks two cancer-driving pathways in colorectal cancer cells, offering potential cancer prevention.

supplements.title: Emerging roles of combined curcumin and berberine in disease modulation: a comprehensive review of mechanisms and therapeutic relevance.
supplements.summary: Curcumin and berberine combined show promise against cancer and multiple diseases by triggering cell death and reducing inflammation through multiple cellular pathways.

supplements.title: A systematic review on the effects of hypercaloric diet in animal models of Alzheimer's disease.
supplements.summary: High-calorie diets worsen memory loss and increase harmful brain protein buildup in Alzheimer's disease animal models.

supplements.title: Identification of Hoiamide A as an Inducer of Oxidative and Endoplasmic Reticulum Secretory Pathway Stress.
supplements.summary: Hoiamide A, a compound from cyanobacteria, triggers oxidative stress in glioblastoma and neuroblastoma cancer cells by disrupting cellular protein pathways.

supplements.title: Associations of dietary diversity with type 2 diabetes in two Chinese cohorts: a multi-omics study.
supplements.summary: Eating a diverse diet reduces type 2 diabetes risk by promoting beneficial gut bacteria and protective metabolites.

supplements.title: Targeting metabolic dysregulation in postmenopausal breast cancer: Synergistic effects of nutrition-based interventions and exercise on molecular and cellular pathways.
supplements.summary: Combined nutrition and exercise interventions help postmenopausal breast cancer patients manage metabolic side effects from hormone therapy treatment.

off_label.title: [Establishment of pediatric neuroblastoma cell line and its resistance mechanism to lorlatinib].
off_label.summary: Researchers found that neuroblastoma cells resistant to lorlatinib activate EGFR as an escape mechanism, and combining EGFR and ALK inhibitors effectively overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Noncanonical PI(4,5)P2 coordinates lysosome positioning through cholesterol trafficking.
off_label.summary: Blocking PI5P4K enzymes disrupts cholesterol transport in p53-deficient cancers, stopping tumor growth through mTOR pathway inhibition.

off_label.title: NAT10-Mediated ac4C Modification of circANKRD12 Reprograms the Tumor Microenvironment.
off_label.summary: NAT10 modification of circANKRD12 promotes multiple myeloma growth and immune suppression; desloratadine reverses both effects.

off_label.title: Repurposing Syrosingopine for Cancer Therapy: Lactate Trapping and ISR Sensitization as Metabolic Vulnerabilities.
off_label.summary: Syrosingopine, a repurposed blood pressure drug, blocks lactate transporters in cancer cells, forcing toxic lactate buildup and potentially slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Ablation of the adhesion G protein-coupled receptor ADGRL1 activates anti-tumor immune response via cDC1-T cell hub formation.
off_label.summary: Removing ADGRL1 protein activates immune cells to fight tumors and works better when combined with immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Synthesis and preliminary enzymatic evaluation of polyol-based 4-phenylbutyrate derivatives.
off_label.summary: Researchers created new drug derivatives combining 4-phenylbutyrate with polyols to potentially treat cancer by targeting cellular stress and energy metabolism.

off_label.title: Phase Ib Study of Imatinib to Increase RUNX1 Activity in Participants With Germline RUNX1 Deficiency
off_label.summary: Researchers test imatinib to boost RUNX1 activity in people with RUNX1 gene mutations who have increased blood cancer risk.

off_label.title: In vitro screening of compounds for targeting gastric cancer with Y220C p53 mutation: a molecule combining zinc chelation and a Michael acceptor drives CDKN1 and BBC3 expression to restore a p53-dependent cytotoxicity.
off_label.summary: A new compound called AG3 reactivates mutated p53 in gastric cancer cells, restoring cancer-killing ability while protecting healthy cells.

off_label.title: Interleukin-34 induced Arg1+ macrophages play a key role in breast cancer brain metastasis.
off_label.summary: Breast cancer cells use interleukin-34 to recruit immune cells that promote brain metastasis, and blocking this pathway shrinks tumors in mice.

off_label.title: Comprehensive quantum chemical analysis, vibrational spectroscopy, molecular docking, ADMET, and in vitro validation studies of hydroxychloroquine-MRGPRX2 complex in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Hydroxychloroquine shows strong binding to a mast cell receptor and reduces glioblastoma cell viability, suggesting potential as a new glioblastoma treatment.

off_label.title: RET signaling as a mediator of estrogen receptor positive breast cancer brain metastasis.
off_label.summary: RET protein drives brain metastasis in estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer and can be blocked by the drug Pralsetinib.

off_label.title: Cross-Species Transcriptomic and Network Analysis of Human and Canine Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma Identifies a Conserved Replication-DNA Damage Module for Drug Repurposing.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified shared DNA damage genes in human and canine lymphoma, suggesting existing drugs like PARP inhibitors could treat dogs with this cancer.

off_label.title: The insulin receptor inhibitor BMS-754807 alleviates neuroinflammation and Alzheimer's disease pathologies across human cellular and mouse models.
off_label.summary: BMS-754807, a drug tested for breast cancer, reduces brain inflammation and Alzheimer's disease symptoms in laboratory and mouse studies.

off_label.title: Anticancer activity of fluoxetine Janus dendrimer against cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Fluoxetine combined with Janus dendrimers shows strong anticancer activity against breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

off_label.title: Simvastatin reprograms lipid metabolism in B16.F10 melanoma cells to favor an early resistant phenotype.
off_label.summary: Simvastatin alters melanoma cell metabolism, but initially triggers survival mechanisms that could lead to drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: Exploring the relationship between Ayurgenomics and bio-psycho-social symptoms in cancer care.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers combined ancient Ayurvedic medicine with genetic analysis to personalize yoga treatments for cancer patients based on individual constitution.

biomarkers.title: The promise of immunotherapy in the treatment of sarcoma: A state-of-the-art review of practice changing research and future directions.
biomarkers.summary: Immunotherapy shows promise for treating soft-tissue sarcoma, particularly when combined with other therapies or used before surgery.

biomarkers.title: An automatic detection model for spread through air spaces in postoperative pathological sections based on deep learning in NSCLC.
biomarkers.summary: AI model accurately detects aggressive lung cancer spread pattern (STAS) in pathology slides, helping pathologists diagnose non-small cell lung cancer more reliably.

biomarkers.title: CTRP3 alleviates neuropathic pain by improving mitochondrial biogenesis and mitochondrial unfolded protein response via spinal SIRT1 in rats.
biomarkers.summary: CTRP3 protein reduces neuropathic pain in rats by improving mitochondrial function through the SIRT1 pathway.

biomarkers.title: Dual roles of lactylation modification in gastric cancer: Crosstalk between metabolic reprogramming and epigenetic regulation (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Lactylation, a metabolic modification, creates a feedback loop that fuels gastric cancer growth and could serve as a treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Ginsenoside Rg3 potentiates cisplatin antitumor activity while mitigating nephrotoxicity through SIRT1‑mediated suppression of the NLRP3 inflammasome.
biomarkers.summary: Ginsenoside Rg3 enhances cisplatin's effectiveness against lung cancer while protecting kidneys from drug damage.

biomarkers.title: Biomarkers of radioresistance in lung cancer: Current insights and future directions (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Researchers review molecular biomarkers that predict radiation resistance in lung cancer to improve treatment outcomes and personalize therapy.

biomarkers.title: Integrin beta 4 promotes colorectal cancer progression by upregulating Ezrin and activating the Wnt/β‑catenin signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: ITGB4 protein drives colorectal cancer growth by activating Ezrin and the Wnt signaling pathway, offering a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Smoldering Multiple Myeloma: From Clinical to Immunogenomic Risk Stratification and Therapeutic Implications of Early Intervention.
biomarkers.summary: Early treatment of high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma based on genetic markers can prevent progression and improve survival.

biomarkers.title: FIGO 2025 Gynecologic Cancers: An Ultrasound-Focused Imaging Update.
biomarkers.summary: Updated guidelines show ultrasound's varying role across six gynecologic cancers, from guiding endometrial diagnosis to assessing ovarian masses and planning cervical cancer treatment.

biomarkers.title: Baseline FDG PET/CT-Defined Axillary Burden Predicts Axillary Pathologic Complete Response After Neoadjuvant Therapy in Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A baseline PET scan measuring lymph node involvement predicts which breast cancer patients will have complete tumor elimination in their lymph nodes after chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: [Predictive value of 18F-FDG PET-CT for the major pathologic response to neoadjuvant immunotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer].
biomarkers.summary: PET-CT scans can accurately predict treatment response in lung cancer patients receiving immunotherapy, with metabolic changes being more predictive than tumor markers.

biomarkers.title: [LncRNA BCYRN1 regulates the miR-125a-5p/HK2 axis to influence radiosensitivity in glioma cells].
biomarkers.summary: Blocking BCYRN1 in glioma cells increases radiation sensitivity by reducing a protein that promotes cell survival.

biomarkers.title: [Establishment of pediatric neuroblastoma cell line and its resistance mechanism to lorlatinib].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that neuroblastoma cells resistant to lorlatinib activate EGFR as an escape mechanism, and combining EGFR and ALK inhibitors effectively overcomes this resistance.

biomarkers.title: Multi-omics dissection of lignan diversity and therapeutic potential in Ocimum: Identification of diphyllin as an anti-inflammatory agent targeting TNF-α signaling.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified diphyllin from Ocimum plants as a compound that reduces inflammation by blocking TNF-α signaling pathways.

trials.title: Comparative efficacy and safety of different acupuncture therapies for insomnia in breast cancer patients: A systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Acupuncture therapies effectively improve sleep quality in breast cancer patients with minimal side effects.

trials.title: Role Perceptions and Workplace Challenges Among Oncology Nurses: A Comparative Study of Türkiye and Australia.
trials.summary: Oncology nurses in Australia and Türkiye report different perceptions of their roles and face varying workplace challenges.

trials.title: The promise of immunotherapy in the treatment of sarcoma: A state-of-the-art review of practice changing research and future directions.
trials.summary: Immunotherapy shows promise for treating soft-tissue sarcoma, particularly when combined with other therapies or used before surgery.

trials.title: Smoldering Multiple Myeloma: From Clinical to Immunogenomic Risk Stratification and Therapeutic Implications of Early Intervention.
trials.summary: Early treatment of high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma based on genetic markers can prevent progression and improve survival.

trials.title: FIGO 2025 Gynecologic Cancers: An Ultrasound-Focused Imaging Update.
trials.summary: Updated guidelines show ultrasound's varying role across six gynecologic cancers, from guiding endometrial diagnosis to assessing ovarian masses and planning cervical cancer treatment.

trials.summary: A baseline PET scan measuring lymph node involvement predicts which breast cancer patients will have complete tumor elimination in their lymph nodes after chemotherapy.

trials.title: [Predictive value of 18F-FDG PET-CT for the major pathologic response to neoadjuvant immunotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer].
trials.summary: PET-CT scans can accurately predict treatment response in lung cancer patients receiving immunotherapy, with metabolic changes being more predictive than tumor markers.

trials.title: Dordaviprone for Diffuse Midline Glioma: A Landmark Approval or a Premature Step?
trials.summary: FDA approved dordaviprone for rare aggressive brain tumors, but additional studies are needed to confirm it truly improves patient survival.

trials.title: Overcoming Primary and Acquired Resistance to Immunotherapy in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: Mechanisms, Challenges, and Emerging Strategies.
trials.summary: Researchers identify mechanisms of immunotherapy resistance in lung cancer and propose combination treatments including new antibodies, gene therapies, and personalized approaches to improve patient outcomes.

trials.title: Evaluating Disparities in Pediatric Cancer Genomic Testing and Sequencing Results at the University of California, San Francisco Using the National Childhood Cancer Registry.
trials.summary: Researchers found that access to genomic testing for childhood cancer varies by patient demographics, potentially contributing to treatment outcome disparities.

trials.title: Bilateral Lipofibromatous Hamartoma of the Median Nerves Presenting as Longstanding Carpal Tunnel Syndrome: A Case Report.
trials.summary: Surgery successfully relieved long-term nerve pain caused by benign fatty growths in both median nerves.

trials.title: Tumor-targeted bispecific antibodies effectively inhibit oncogenic pathways while minimizing toxicity.
trials.summary: Bispecific antibodies targeting tumor-specific proteins effectively block cancer-driving pathways while sparing healthy tissues.

trials.title: Multiregional profiling reveals THBS1-SPP1 monocyte-macrophage axis drives immunosuppression and outcome in colorectal liver metastases.
trials.summary: Researchers discovered that specific immune cells called SPP1+ macrophages suppress anti-tumor immunity in colorectal cancer liver metastases, offering a new treatment target.

trials.title: Comparison of dose-adjusted EPOCH-R and R-CHOP in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with high Ki67 expression: Results from a prospective observational study.
trials.summary: Dose-adjusted EPOCH-R may be more effective than R-CHOP for treating aggressive B-cell lymphoma with high growth rates.

trials.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Cladribine in Relapsing-Remitting Multiple Sclerosis in Clinical Practice: A 2-Year Multicenter Retrospective Open-Label Study.
trials.summary: Cladribine, an oral drug, proved effective and safe for treating relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis in real-world patients over two years.
